title: Install and configure ESLint with TypeScript support
description: Install ESLint with TypeScript parser and plugin support. Configure using the new flat config format (eslint.config.js). Enable TypeScript-recommended rules plus warnings for unused variables and explicit any types.
acceptanceCriteria: eslint.config.js exists at project root using flat config format
no-unused-vars is configured as a warning
no-explicit-any is configured as a warning
npm run lint exits with code 0 on a clean project

steps.description: Install ESLint and TypeScript ESLint packages
steps.details: Run: `npm install --save-dev eslint @typescript-eslint/parser @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin`. Use the latest compatible versions.

steps.description: Create eslint.config.js with flat config format
steps.details: Create eslint.config.js at project root. Import typescript-eslint and set up: import tseslint from 'typescript-eslint'; export default tseslint.config({ files: ['src/**/*.ts', 'bin/**/*.ts'], extends: [...tseslint.configs.recommended], rules: { '@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars': 'warn', '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any': 'warn' } })
Update the lint script in package.json to: 'eslint src/ bin/'. This lints both source directories.

steps.description: Verify lint passes on clean project
steps.details: Run `npm run lint`. On a project with only src/index.ts containing a simple export, it should exit 0. If it errors, check that the flat config format is correct for your eslint version.

technicalNotes: ESLint v9+ uses flat config (eslint.config.js) — the old .eslintrc format is deprecated
The typescript-eslint v8+ package consolidates both parser and plugin into one package
